    k-duality and the opposite algebra #

    For a k-algebra R and an R-module M with a compatible k-structure, the k-dual M →ₗ[k] k is an Rᵐᵒᵖ-module (DualMod). For finite-dimensional R, duality shows that R is representation-finite iff Rᵐᵒᵖ is (isRepresentationFinite_mop).
